title: lane r5 SE+QE: skipped pin satisfies the green half; skipped state unenumerated
description: Lane round 5. Lenses: SE + QE merged, both halves (validators: SO, SE). Owner: SO session. Defect: green is never defined as an executed pass — a skipped, ignored, filtered, or cfg-excluded pin reports zero-failure exit-0 and passes the green half while the fixed behavior goes unexercised (a fix can simply add ignore to its own pin); collected-but-not-run also fits no recordable kind. Citations verified: contract:64, :173. Proposed: resolved-candidate (green defined symmetrically — built, collected, ran, passed; a skipped pin is neither red nor green, recorded as its own state satisfying neither half; skipped kind joins the 1c enumeration; skipped-at-HEAD fixture).
